en: A black-and-white postcard showing a hilly, forested landscape with several large buildings in the foreground, possibly villas or hotels, and a small town nestled among the trees in the mid-background. The text at the top reads 'Blick vom Spitzberg auf Bärenfels u. Kipsdorf', suggesting a view from Spitzberg towards the villages of Bärenfels and Kipsdorf. The area is mountainous and appears rural and serene.
